verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe calculating sales tax during checkout through the REST v2 CreateTransaction API, with SDKs in six languages. They also cover address validation that maps transactions to the correct tax jurisdictions, and a street-address-level calculation example. Missing for 10: explicit rooftop/geocode-level accuracy claims as distinct from ZIP-based lookup, documented latency/SLA figures proving checkout-suitable speed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
